name: Tai video Youtube (batch link -> MP4/MP3 + thumbnail)
description: Dan nhieu link Youtube (moi dong 1 link). Chon chat luong (Best/2160p/1440p/1080p/720p/480p/360p) va dinh dang (MP4 hoac MP3). Ten file output = tieu de video. Tai kem thumbnail .jpg cung ten. Khong re-encode: MP4 chi doi container (remux). Loai bo AV1 o moi muc chat luong vi ffmpeg bundled (2018) khong mux duoc AV1 vao MP4; voi 1440p/2160p file MP4 co the chua VP9 thay vi H.264 - mot so player cu co the khong mo duoc. File da co san trong Output se duoc bo qua. CAN Node.js tren may (kiem tra bang 'node --version'): tu 2026-08 Youtube chan moi duong tai khong co JS runtime - xem ghi chu o player_client va js_runtimes ben duoi.
_comment_player_client: ADR-011. Da doi tu 'android_vr' sang 'web_embedded' ngay 2026-08-18. Ly do: android_vr VAN lay duoc metadata (tieu de) nhung BI CHAN o khau tai du lieu - 'HTTP Error 403: Forbidden' - vi Youtube nay doi GVS PO Token cho client do (yt-dlp issue #17348). Da do that tren nhieu video va tren CA HAI ban yt-dlp: 403 khong tru video nao. Da thu 9 client khac: KHONG cai nao tai duoc ma khong can JS runtime (ios/android_vr doi PO Token; mweb/tv_simply/web_music/web/tv doi giai 'n challenge'; web_creator doi dang nhap). Vi vay web_embedded + js_runtimes la duong DUY NHAT con chay duoc.
_comment_js_runtimes: ADR-011. BAT BUOC di kem player_client=web_embedded: client do phai giai 'n challenge' bang JavaScript. Thieu no thi 0 format video ('Only images are available'). Gia tri 'node' yeu cau may da cai Node.js (kiem tra: 'node --version'); dat 'deno' neu may dung Deno. Luu y: yt-dlp KHONG tu do Node du Node nam san tren PATH - co --js-runtimes ghi ro no la runtime 'Additional', phai khai bao tuong minh o day. De trong ('') se tat co, va khi do web_embedded se KHONG tai duoc gi.
